description: The AEREDIUM doorway's hook on every tool call, the verifier at the start of a session (on startup and on resume), and the session's close at its end. The PreToolUse entry carries the 960-second timeout and block-on-failure of the managed hook; the plugin carries no policy, no rule, no key and no server declared for Claude Code: the model does not hold the judge's tools; the hook is the fitting.
